title: Ash and Pikachu become friends.
lines: A boy lives in a little village.
He wants to be the best Pokémon trainer in the world.
There are lots and lots of them.
Today Ash may choose his first Pokémon at Professor Oak's.
He runs to the professor in his pyjamas.
The other children have already chosen.
The professor opens a red and white ball.
Out jumps a little yellow creature.
With long ears with black tips, red cheeks and a tail like a lightning bolt.
This is Pikachu, says the professor.
But Pikachu doesn't want to go into the ball.
He doesn't want to listen either.
When Ash tries to stroke him, Ash gets a shock.
Ash wants to carry Pikachu, but Pikachu would rather walk by himself.
In a field Ash sees a bird.
It's a Spearow, an angry bird Pokémon.
And he calls all his friends!
A whole flock of angry birds flies towards them.
Ash picks up Pikachu and runs.
He stands in front of Pikachu, with his arms spread wide.
This boy really wants to protect him.
An enormous bolt of lightning shoots out of Pikachu.
The birds fly away in fright.
The sun comes through the clouds.
And high in the sky flies a beautiful golden bird.
Ash and Pikachu watch it together.
From that day on they're best friends.
Pikachu doesn't walk behind Ash anymore.
He always sits on his shoulder.
And they have a thousand more adventures together.
